stable.notes: The pet fight plays for real, and the character has its own size dial. Character size (100-300%) scales the figure while Pet size keeps the card, and the panel now measures the actual art instead of assuming a wide cinematic frame, so the card sits tight around the figure. Story strips drop the scenes their subject is absent from, cinematic frames align to their cells and cross-dissolve, and three sessions no longer animate the same as five. A Cursor pet click opens that session's Agents tab: prefix-aware row matching, a search fallback for rows scrolled out of view, and File > New Agent recovery when the window is closed. Pet controls read in dark mode. Reinstall your sprite pack once so it reprocesses through the fixed pipeline. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
